summary: Genenta Science S.p.A., a foreign private issuer on Nasdaq, filed Form 6-K to disclose a business transformation from biotech to an industrial consolidator targeting Italian national-security-regulated sectors. It notes completed 100% acquisition of A.T.C. S.r.l. in May 2026 and a 19.9% stake in Sòphia High Tech with a performance-driven tranche to reach 51%. The filing outlines proposed industry classification changes to aerospace/defense. No specific deal terms, prices, or advisors were disclosed. Watch for subsequent acquisition announcements and classification provider decisions as the transformation progresses.
